headline: 本周影剧速览：街头霸王领跑 幻视任务首播
summary: 电影端，《街头霸王》《黑球》《鲸口脱险》本周热作领跑，待映还有《复仇者联盟5》《沙丘3》。剧集端，新剧《幻视任务》《降世神通：七净土》首播，《侠探杰克》《绿灯军团》等持续热播。

headlineEn: This Week in Film & TV: Street Fighter Leads, Vision Quest Premieres
summaryEn: On the film side, Street Fighter, Black Ball, and Whale Mouth Escape lead this week's hits, with Avengers 5 and Dune 3 still upcoming. On TV, Vision Quest and Avatar: The Seven Havens premiere, while Reacher and Green Lantern Corps stay hot.
